title: DOOM FLEX
heroTitle: Pay in 3, 6 or 12 months. 0% interest. No fees.
heroText: Split the cash price into equal monthly instalments, paid from your DOOM Wallet. You never pay more than the price.

how.title: How it works
how.s1: Choose a product and a duration on its page.
how.s2: Verify your identity once (ID card and selfie).
how.s3: Submit your application — nothing is charged.
how.s4: After approval, review the schedule and accept the terms: your order is confirmed.
how.s5: Pay each instalment from your DOOM Wallet.

mine.title: My FLEX plans
mine.emptyText: Choose a product and select DOOM FLEX on its page.

faq.title: Questions
faq.a1: Yes. The sum of the instalments equals the cash price, to the baisa. No interest, no fees.
faq.q2: Why is the last instalment sometimes slightly different?
faq.a2: Amounts are in baisa: when the price does not divide exactly, the last instalment absorbs the remainder.
faq.q3: Why do I need to verify my identity?
faq.a3: DOOM FLEX is a credit: identity verification protects you and us. Your documents are encrypted.
faq.q4: How do I pay the instalments?
faq.a4: From your DOOM Wallet balance, from your plan page. Top up your wallet before each due date.

terms.title: DOOM FLEX terms
terms.t1: 0% interest and no fees: you repay exactly the amount financed.
terms.t2: {months} monthly instalments, paid from your DOOM Wallet; the last one absorbs baisa rounding.
terms.t3: A late instalment is marked overdue, and you cannot open another plan until it is paid.
terms.t4: Your order is confirmed and delivered once you accept. Returns and refunds follow our returns policy.
